turn1.query: Which paper fine-tunes a LLaMA model to write correct API calls and trains it together with a document retriever so it hallucinates fewer APIs?

final.status: done · TTFT 22910 ms · total 24315 ms · retrieval 1915 ms · openai 6 calls, 14856→637 tok

turn1.answer_text:
The paper is **“Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs”** ([arXiv:2305.15334v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.15334v1)). It introduces a fine-tuned LLaMA model for generating accurate API calls while reducing hallucinations. [C1]

Specifically, Gorilla fine-tunes **LLaMA-7B** using **retriever-aware training**, which adds API documentation to training prompts so the model learns to use it when generating calls; the paper reports reduced hallucination errors and better adaptation to documentation changes. [C3]
